thesis: The episode discusses the evolution of client utility functions from seeking mythical uncorrelated alpha to acknowledging the cost of defensive strategies. It highlights that uncorrelated strategies statistically have a 50-50 chance of performing well or badly during market downturns, which often leads clients to perceive them as positively correlated when they fail to hedge downside risk.
